facts.fact: Statutory Instrument No. 56 of 2025 is made under section 40 of the Access to Information Act, 2023 (Act No. 24 of 2023), which it treats as the law governing requests for information.
facts.system: Access to Information Act, 2023 (Act No. 24 of 2023)

facts.fact: The Minister of Information and Media made the Access to Information (General) Regulations, 2025 (SI 56 of 2025), setting request forms, fees and procedures; signed 20 August 2025.
